items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I knew a guy they called Raymond Dorris.

ctx.x: We was playing down by Rockford Lewis place, used to have a hall, huh? The name of all they called Rockford Lewis. And we was working all down in the volley. The clubs down there. Howard had so much work, we had to tell them to turn it down. Working over at the Naval Base, going every night with Howard. Raymond Lewis, I can't play. I knew a guy they called Raymond Dorris. Oh, he's done, yeah. Yeah, that's a different guy. No, Raymond don't play anymore. Hillingman, Broke's Jaw, that club that was playing there.…
